pattern: とは比べものにならない（とはくらべものにならない）
aliases: とはくらべものにならない
purpose: Emphasize a gap too large for a normal comparison.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
N + とは比べものにならない
The new model is incomparably faster than the old one.
The cold at the summit is nothing like the cold in town.
The effort of doing it by hand is vastly greater than using a machine.
formation: N + とは比べものにならない
restrictions: Context should make the direction of the difference clear.
mistake: The phrase alone does not specify whether the new thing is better or worse.
